card.name: Words just before an interaction effect
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "is" right after "the action of levodopa" in the pyridoxine interaction warning. Also fires on a few other spots just before a drug-interaction or interference statement.

modes.label: Levodopa action is antagonized
modes.description: The verb "is" after "the action of levodopa" or "the latter drug", before "antagonized by pyridoxine".
modes.example: Interactions: Ribotin-E TM is not recommended for and should not be given to patients receiving levodopa because the action of levodopa<< is>> antagonized by pyridoxine.

modes.label: Other interaction-text spots
modes.description: Scattered points inside interaction or co-administration sentences, such as a comma in a list of CYP enzymes or the middle of a drug name.
modes.example: minimal concentration changes may increase the risk of adverse reactions, follow recommendations for co-administration with CYP2C8, CYP2C19<<,>> CYP3A, P-gp

card.writes: It suppresses words meaning "unaffected" or "intact", which fits a sentence about to say an effect is changed.
card.plain: It marks the point in an interaction warning where the text is about to say one drug's action is altered by another.
